title: Financial Instruments
summary: Governs classification, measurement, ECL provisioning, and hedge accounting for financial instruments, substantially converged with IFRS 9 with a distinctive RBI parallel prudential provisioning overlay for Indian banks.

bannerNotice.title: Substantially converged with IAS/IFRS
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 109 mirrors IFRS 9's classification, ECL, and hedge accounting model almost exactly. The genuinely important Indian context is RBI's separate, parallel prudential provisioning framework for banks, creating a distinctive dual system still in transition.
